description: This file defines the class SyncInboundEmailAccountsInvalidSubActionArgumentsException, a custom exception class used within the SuiteCRM system to handle cases where an action is called with incorrect arguments. It provides a method to retrieve the caller method name from the call stack for debugging purposes.
